collection.description: A landslide threatens homes, and four advisers propose different responses.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A landslide threatens homes, and four advisers propose different responses.

choices.label: Ask the Nature master to reinforce the hillside.
Ask the Science master to study the slope.
Ask the Magic master to stabilize the rocks.
Ask the spiritual elder to guide a communal departure.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Roots help hold the soil, though the work takes seasons.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The plants fail to establish before the next rain.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A survey identifies the safest relocation site.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The survey is incomplete when the slope moves again.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A dangerous boulder settles into place.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The spell fails, and the adept urges evacuation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A ceremony helps families leave together.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Some villagers refuse to wait for the ritual and depart early.
